The `PlanBooking` body of RWB-S2-E3010-CON carries eight properties: `nleadsRef` (DF-TRT-023), `alsBookingRef` (no treatment column; carried on the booking record and the decision record), `bookedAt` (DF-TRT-012), `firstDueDate` (DF-TRT-029), `installmentCount` (DF-TRT-009), `installmentAmount` (DF-TRT-031), `installmentsPaid` (DF-TRT-032) and `bookingDifference` (DF-TRT-028). The first seven are required, because R-RES-22 needs both acknowledgements and R-RES-25 needs a first due date; the required set is published here so that no implementer invents a column for the ALS reference (GAP-2666; GAP-2665).
